mainEntity.name: Are there any specific considerations for tile and surface updates in older homes in the Berkeley or Oakland area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Older homes in areas like Berkeley and Oakland often have unique characteristics that require specific considerations for tile and surface updates. These can include uneven subfloors, plaster walls, or existing architectural details that need careful integration or preservation. We assess the structural integrity and existing conditions to recommend solutions that respect the home's character while ensuring modern standards of durability and functionality, sometimes requiring more extensive preparation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Older homes in Berkeley/Oakland may have uneven subfloors or plaster walls requiring careful assessment and integration with existing architectural details. This might lead to more extensive preparation.
